label: 1961 · observed serial, ط and year roles
note: Clean source-guided reconstruction from the inspected DNA archive / Gordon photograph; provisional contours, not an authenticated die. All glyphs retain one source-plane scale and baseline. Wear, glare and pixel stair-steps are excluded; low resolution and residual photographic perspective limit precision. The city initial and year figures are separately traced role alphabets with their own shared source metrics, never reduced copies of the main serial font. Numeric repertoires now include explicitly labelled inferred source-style outlines for absent digits; the original observed contours are unchanged and remain individually distinguishable.
